title: Wie entwickelt sich die vergleichbare Interaktion danach?
observableEvidence: same interaction described before and after a visible adjustment
trade-off or problem shift when visible, without outcome bias
requiredForStrong: keeps problem, adjustment, and response distinct
does not treat goals/outcomes as proof of interaction quality
fairnessNote: Excellent means excellent interaction-chain discipline for THIS drill — trade-off honesty beats highlight storytelling.
minimalInputChange: Required chainSummary (≥40) plus problem/adjustment/response descriptions already usable.
